identity: A green-base Domain Ramp deck that treats basic land TYPES, not colours, as the resource it accumulates. Eight common typed dual lands cover all five basic land types between them, and Slimefoot's Survey, The Weatherseed Treaty and Floriferous Vinewall add more. Measured against the actual list (40k-hand simulation, on the play, optimal land ordering and optimal fetches), the deck has domain 4 in 76% of games by turn five and domain 5 in 58%; by turn seven those are 88% and 78%. It converts that type count straight into board: Territorial Maro is a 10/10 for five at domain 5, Briar Hydra a 6/6 trampler that adds five +1/+1 counters per connection, and Herd Migration makes five 3/3 Beasts from one card. A Leyline Binding that costs {W} at domain 5 and two Meria's Outriders (5 damage to the face on entry) are the same counter spent on removal and reach.

sideboard.name: Magnigoth Sentry
sideboard.oracle_text: Reach (This creature can block creatures with flying.)
sideboard.when_to_board: In against fliers, the cube's largest threat class at 51 cards (41 with flying). 'Reach' on a 4/4 for four blocks and kills essentially every flier in the pool.

sideboard.name: Snarespinner
sideboard.oracle_text:
Reach
Whenever this creature blocks a creature with flying, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against cheap aggressive fliers. 'Reach | Whenever this creature blocks a creature with flying, this creature gets +2/+0' is a two-mana 1/3 that blocks as a 3/3.

sideboard.name: Tear Asunder
sideboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{B} (You may pay an additional {1}{B} as you cast this spell.)
Exile target artifact or enchantment. If this spell was kicked, exile target nonland permanent instead.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against the cube's 15 artifacts and 18 enchantments (33 cards, 13.4%). '{1}{G} Exile target artifact or enchantment' at instant speed; the {1}{B} kicker is unavailable in these colours and is not needed for the base mode. Answers Citizen's Arrest, Prayer of Binding and Temporary Lockdown, which otherwise exile this deck's single oversized threat.

sideboard.name: Hexbane Tortoise
sideboard.oracle_text:
Ward {2} (Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {2}.)
Enlist (As this creature attacks, you may tap a nonattacking creature you control without summoning sickness. When you do, add its power to this creature's until end of turn.)
sideboard.when_to_board: In against fast clocks. A {2}{G} 3/2 with 'Ward {2}' is on the board by turn three, unlike a seven-mana body; ward taxes the removal that would clear the way for a race.

sideboard.name: Artillery Blast
sideboard.oracle_text: Domain — Artillery Blast deals X damage to target tapped creature, where X is 1 plus the number of basic land types among lands you control.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against creature decks that must attack. 'deals X damage to target tapped creature, where X is 1 plus the number of basic land types' is 6 damage for two mana at domain 5; dead against a deck that never taps out, which is why only one copy is maindecked.

sideboard.when_to_board: Second copy, in against creature decks. One mana to fight using a Territorial Maro or Briar Hydra as the removal spell.

Medido contra la lista real (simulación de 40.000 manos, jugando primero, con orden de tierras y búsquedas óptimos), el mazo tiene domain 4 en el 76% de las partidas para el turno cinco y domain 5 en el 58%; para el turno siete son el 88% y el 78%. Convierte ese recuento de tipos directamente en tablero: Territorial Maro es un 10/10 por cinco con domain 5, Briar Hydra un arrollador 6/6 que añade cinco contadores +1/+1 por conexión, y Herd Migration crea cinco Bestias 3/3 con una sola carta. Una Leyline Binding que cuesta {W} con domain 5 y dos Meria's Outriders (5 de daño a la cara al entrar) son ese mismo recuento gastado en eliminación y alcance.
